rowe-kennicutt-2009-qe2-isoline.citation: Rowe and Kennicutt (2009), Northern Gulf of Mexico Continental Slope Habitats and Benthic Ecology Study, Final Report, MMS 2009-039, July 2009.
rowe-kennicutt-2009-qe2-isoline.access: Original report and native 971 × 950 chart verified by SHA-256. Figure 8-5 and its eastern split-feature identification on the following page were visually reviewed. Four visible extrema of the plotted 5 cm SSH isoline are read manually; closed topology and physical boundary are unverified.

records.period_label: Chart labeled August 8, 2002; exact simultaneous observation time unspecified.
records.case_label: QE2 eastern split feature; plotted 5 cm SSH isoline, physical identity unverified
records.source_locator: Figure 8-5, printed page 82 / PDF page 104; named Quick-west/QE2-east split description on printed page 83 / PDF page 105.
records.definition: Geographic east–west bounding span read manually from the visible extrema of the plotted 5 cm SSH isoline around the eastern QE2 source feature.
records.scope: Specified chart-isoline extent, not full physical eddy size or a speed-core estimate. The source SSH reference is unspecified.
records.qualification: The unlabeled 5 cm line is identified between the labeled 0 and 10 cm contours using the 5 cm color-key intervals. Four extrema are read manually. Six native pixels per extremum and ±2 pixels on six axis anchors across 64 scenarios, with outward 25 km reporting, describe reading sensitivity only. Source analysis error, line interpretation, raster/axis distortion and physical uncertainty remain unquantified. The 10 cm text-covered inner contour, outer 0 cm contour, Quick to the west, northern highs and main Loop Current are excluded. Punctuation-normalized QE2/QE-2 association is qualified source context, not a verified physical crosswalk. The earlier multiple-peak speed-core and closed-ink rejections remain unchanged. No closure, repaired line, footprint, radius, diameter, principal width, state containment, ranking, annual range or seasonal playback inferred.
